FAQ.Q0: How to pay for the order?
FAQ.A0: After placing the order, click 'Pay with Kaspi'. You will be redirected to the Kaspi.kz app for the transfer.
FAQ.Q1: Where to pick up the food?
FAQ.A1: At the selected venue. When the order status changes to 'Ready', just provide your unique receipt code.
FAQ.A2: An order can only be cancelled before the kitchen starts preparing it. Contact support if you have any issues.
FAQ.A3: If you place an order but do not pay, it will be cancelled automatically after 5 minutes. Venue owners cannot cancel an order once it has been accepted.

FOOTER.TEXT: Fast food and drink pre-orders at university canteens.

ABOUT.HERO_SUB: A food pre-order platform that eliminates queues in university canteens.
ABOUT.PROJECT_P1: Dium is a platform for pre-ordering food and drinks at university canteens. Students order from their phone during class, pay online, and pick up their ready order — no queue.
ABOUT.PROJECT_P2: We are building an ecosystem that connects students and venue owners within the university environment. We started in the KBTU ecosystem and we're growing.
ABOUT.PROBLEM_BODY: Students lose 10–15 minutes of their break waiting in line. Canteens can't handle peak-time crowds. Time is wasted, food gets cold.
ABOUT.SOLUTION_TITLE: Order during class — food ready at the bell
ABOUT.SOLUTION_BODY: The pre-order goes to the kitchen in advance. By break time the food is ready. The student just walks up and grabs it.
ABOUT.VAL1_BODY: Every feature is built to be faster, simpler, and clearer.
ABOUT.VAL2_BODY: Transparent payments and fair conditions for both owners and students.
ABOUT.VAL3_BODY: We're open to new partners and constantly expanding our reach.
ABOUT.MEMBER1_BIO: System architecture, development and all technical integrations of the platform.
ABOUT.MEMBER2_BIO: Responsible for product, strategy, partnerships and business development.
ABOUT.MEMBER3_BIO: Built two-factor authentication and keeps sign-in and user data secure.
ABOUT.CTA_SUB: Order food without queues or connect your venue to the platform.

TRACTION.SUBTITLE: Key milestones from launch to first contracts
TRACTION.N1_BODY: We completed development and officially entered the market. The platform solves key pain points in automation and supply — architecture built to scale, interface built for ease of use.
TRACTION.N2_TITLE: First deal: KBTU residents choose our product
TRACTION.N2_BODY: KBTU is a strong brand and a mark of quality. We signed a contract with our first client from this ecosystem — chosen for solving their core challenges better than the competition.
TRACTION.N3_TITLE: First users on the platform: All systems go!
TRACTION.N3_BODY: First real users successfully onboarded. Registration and initial setup went smoothly — the interface is intuitive from minute one. Early feedback confirms the system works in real conditions.
TRACTION.N4_TITLE: From theory to practice: First real orders processed
TRACTION.N4_BODY: The most important business traction. Real commercial orders have been placed and processed through the system — proof that the platform delivers value right now.
TRACTION.N5_TITLE: Platform update: Automated notifications via WhatsApp API
TRACTION.N5_BODY: All key order status updates now arrive directly in WhatsApp — the most popular messenger in Kazakhstan. No more constant checking of the dashboard.
TRACTION.N6_TITLE: Growing presence: Second major contract in the KBTU ecosystem
TRACTION.N6_BODY: A second client from the same environment proves the first success was no accident. Word-of-mouth and network effects are kicking in within the segment.
TRACTION.N7_TITLE: Scaling plans: Open for partnership and growth
TRACTION.N7_BODY: We launched, validated hypotheses, shipped features, and landed contracts. The platform is ready for mass expansion and open to new partners.
TRACTION.CTA_SUB: Become part of a growing platform

SECURITY.TITLE: Two-factor authentication
SECURITY.SUBTITLE: Extra protection for sign-in
SECURITY.DESC: Besides your password, sign-in will require a one-time code. Even if someone learns your password, they won't be able to access your account.
SECURITY.REQUIRED_NOTE: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for your role.
SECURITY.REQUIRED_NOTE_DEFAULT: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for your role: a code is sent via WhatsApp at every sign-in. You can connect an authenticator app and get backup codes.
SECURITY.SETUP_TOTP_STEP1: Install Google Authenticator or another authenticator app.
SECURITY.SETUP_TOTP_STEP2: Scan the QR code in the app or enter the key manually.
SECURITY.QR_ALT: QR code for the authenticator app
SECURITY.SETUP_TOTP_STEP3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
SECURITY.SETUP_WA_SUB: We sent a code via WhatsApp to your number. Enter it to turn on protection.
SECURITY.BACKUP_WARNING: Keep these codes somewhere safe — we show them only once. Each code lets you sign in once if you don't have access to your phone.
SECURITY.REGENERATE_SUB: Your old backup codes will stop working. Enter your password to confirm.
SECURITY.DISABLE_SUB: Your account will be protected by the password only. Enter your password and a code to confirm.
SECURITY.DISABLE_SUB_REQUIRED: 2FA is mandatory for your role: after turning it off, a sign-in code will be sent via WhatsApp. Enter your password and a code to confirm.
SECURITY.ENABLED_OK: Two-factor authentication is on and protecting your account
SECURITY.ERR_GENERIC: Couldn't complete the action. Please try again later
